final_model_note: The final model consumes official sample metadata only (compound, strain, medium, source, instrument, plate, temperature, time). No entry below reaches inference.
test_derived_content: none — no test proteome, matched-control truth or scoring result was used to generate, filter, normalise or calibrate any external feature

sources.name: 1011 Yeast Genomes public matrices
sources.licence: venue open-access terms; source-provider attribution retained
sources.entities_mapped: 5 competition strains matched exactly (BAH=SX3, BAI=BJ6, CEK=JCM_2985-4B, CGD=UCD_09-448, CRD=FIMA_3)

sources.name: NCBI RefSeq S288C R64 assembly and annotation
sources.entities_mapped: protein gene names; DHY210 explicitly flagged proxy_flag=1, never treated as an exact 1011 row
sources.used_for: protein sequence lookup for the ESM2 output-head experiment (negative result)

sources.name: PubChem compound structures
sources.entities_mapped: 57 compound labels: 49 MAPPED, 3 AMBIGUOUS, 4 UNMAPPED, 1 QC_EXCLUDED; no ambiguous label is guessed into a structure
sources.used_for: P3 / C1 / C1R chemical-feature falsification (negative result)

sources.name: NeuML/pubmedbert-base-embeddings
sources.entities_mapped: 54 compounds x 768 dims; mean pooling over attention mask, no L2 normalisation, max_seq_length 512, fp32, CPU, one sequence at a time
sources.used_for: DCB-40 primary content channel phi_TXT (Gate-0 not passed; negative result)
sources.preregistered: model id and revision locked before any rho was computed; not chosen by comparing downstream results
sources.abstention_rule: compounds without substantive mechanism text get amplitude 0 (exact fallback); no mechanism is guessed

sources.name: Structured mechanism priors (LLM-authored, cached)
sources.licence: generated text, released with this package
sources.entities_mapped: per-compound mechanism summaries; no proteome truth of any split is read by the generation step
sources.used_for: M3 / SSPS Gate-0 and the DCB-40 C2 ablation (both negative)
